_comment: Per-family choices that replace an automatic rule. Each records who chose it, when and why; the automatic result is kept in the output for comparison.

display_representative.reason: RAD reference structure used by the research head-rotation analysis (head rotation 0.0 deg, classical tRNA state); all 1513 matched positions observed; PDBe 2D available. The automatic rule picks 4V9O PG, whose head is rotated by 10.7 deg, which would make a rotated state the orientation frame.

all 50 chains are cryo-EM, so the automatic rule (X-ray first) finds no eligible chain; 9OWQ A (Lee et al. 2026, RNA alone + pre-tRNA, closed TL-TLR, 2.78 A) is the best-resolution chain with a PDBe 2D topology and a published study. The research orientation reference 9OVC A has no PDBe 2D topology; the best-resolution chain overall, 9OWY A (2.69 A), is unpublished and has none either.
